claude_code.verification_method: claude --version on the maintainer machine; latest from registry.npmjs.org/@anthropic-ai/claude-code; standalone install verified with `claude plugin marketplace add` + `claude plugin install`

cursor.supported_min_source: Cursor documents no minimum version for plugins; the floor is set to the version actually validated rather than guessed

codex.supported_min_source: earliest release this repo has claimed AGENTS.md + .codex-plugin manifest support for
codex.verification_method: codex --version on the maintainer machine; standalone install verified with `codex plugin marketplace add` against this repo root

opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which `skills.paths` discovery of this repo's skills was verified with `opencode debug skill`
opencode.verification_method: opencode --version on the maintainer machine; latest from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai; all 11 skills confirmed loaded with `opencode debug skill`

capability_gaps.marketplace: No plugin marketplace — install is by clone plus `skills.paths` or a symlink into the OpenCode skills directory.
capability_gaps.mcp_autowiring: `.mcp.json` is not read; the fantasy-wc MCP server must be declared by hand under `mcp` in opencode.json.
capability_gaps.slash_commands: Skills are model-invoked rather than exposed as `/squad-advice`-style slash commands.
